targets.name: how to use this thing now

qT.text:
Okay, it's kinda simple kinda complicated I guess idk but uhh

Basically get your json, select all of it, copy it. And then go to chart converter for ays and camera converter for ays, paste your json in there, click see inside and right click the list, and then click export on the list.

Put the chart in "chart" list and put the camera in "MustHitCamera"

And uh yeah idk, you're pretty much good.

Chart converter: https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/666734314/

Camera converter: https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/676037407/
